correctness.rationale: For k>=3, all squares mod 2^k split disjointly into odd squares congruent 1 mod8 (2^{k-3} classes) and 4Q_{k-2}; the kth Fourier transform consequently repeats depth k-2 away from eight frequencies a divisible by 2^{k-3}. At these eight, the inherited transform is c_k=s_{k-2} for even u and d_k=s_{k-4}-2^{k-5} for odd u (zero at k4), and adding h_k times an eighth-root phase yields exactly the displayed radical two-step increment. Endpoint convolution norms equal the L1 kernel norm by point-mass/phase extremizers. For k>=5, c/h=1/3+a/(3h), d/h=-1/6+a/(3h) with a=4 or5; two-Lipschitz of each modulus difference bounds |Delta_k-C| by 80/(3*2^k). Parity subsequences give two absolutely convergent offsets and tail 80/(9*2^k). Independent direct radix-2 FFT of all squares k1..10 matches recurrence, Parseval and asymptotic C=0.7670312695942494. Thus all-depth proof is mathematical rather than computational extrapolation.
